svg.title: Fullstack App With TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Prisma & GraphQL: GraphQL API
svg.desc: Two struck-through REST paths, /users and /favorites, sit above a large mono /api/graphql underlined in Postgres yellow, with the line "One request instead of a waterfall of REST calls" — the single Next.js API route that replaces them in part two of the fullstack course. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.
